text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the day Curren Chan starts seriously training for the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Curren Chan is a top sprinter, and her strength shines brightest at 1,200 meters.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big Bro! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big Sis! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: How'd I do? I ran as fast as I could!

I'm looking forward to seeing you grow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If she really continues to work hard at sprints, I'm sure she could be a top-level sprinter. But…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I need a pic to commemorate the occasion! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Take it for me!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan

text_block_list.text: "My real training starts now! #DoMyBest #CheerForMe #CuteCurrenChan"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The key is figuring out how to handle this social media queen who has mastered the art of making everyone march to the beat of her drum.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Oh! It's Curren! She really is a cutie!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Hey, she's training. You shouldn't bother her.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Haha! It's okay! Thanks for saying hi! ♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Yay! You said hi back! But aren't we disturbing your training?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Don't worry! I'm almost done for the day.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: It's my first day, so we just wanted to do some basics and see where I'm at. Right, Big Bro?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: See? No problem. Ask me anything you want. ♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Squeal! Thank you! I-I always look at your Umastagram, and…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I wanted to have a meeting about her future plans, but with the fans here looking so happy, I suppose it will have to wait.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Because of this, I tell Curren Chan a few days later that I have something important to talk to her about. However…

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: Here you go! Our brand new Mega Fluffy French Toast!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: It's heeere! It's exactly what I wanted! It's so cute! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: A selfie with aaall this whipped cream is gonna look so good. I just know it'll be a big hit, so I had to get my hands on one!
choice_data_list: That's why you wanted to come here?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: You said you wanted to talk about something important, but you didn't say it was a secret or anything, so I figured it'd be okay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I try not to pay any mind to our surroundings. In order to decide how we tackle the future, the first thing we need to discuss is…
choice_data_list: I'd like to know what your dream is.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Sure! I want everyone to know about Cute Curren! ♪
choice_data_list: I-I was thinking more along the lines of a racing goal…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Oh, a racing goal? Hmmm… I don't really have one!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Don't look so surprised! Your eyes look like they're gonna pop out!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Oh, but… there is something I'm kinda interested in.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: The Triple Tiara sounds really fancy and cute. Don't you think it would suit me perfectly?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Runners have to win three particular G1 races—the Oka Sho, the Japanese Oaks, and the Shuka Sho—in order to claim the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's a huge honor, but the shortest race, the Oka Sho, is still 1,600 meters. That's pretty tough for a sprinter like Curren.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell her as much.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: For now, maybe we just see how much we can increase my distance?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: We've only just started training, so I think it's too early to decide what direction I should go in.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I'm great with 1,200 meters, so next is 1,400. If I can do that, then we can move up to 1,600 and just keep extending little by little. Whaddya think?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If we do as she says and get results, we might be able to try the Triple Tiara. Plus—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: If we're gonna go for it, we may as well go big. ♪ Wouldn't you agree?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: If we're gonna go for it, we may as well go big. ♪ Wouldn't you agree?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: —if she has a dream, I want to do my best to support her as her trainer!
